lessons_learned.primary_finding: Backtest Result Contract v1.0 audit_bt_result must validate frequency-vs-data-cadence consistency, not just check that metric_type label is set. Currently audit passes if 'frequency' field is set, regardless of actual data spacing.
lessons_learned.secondary_finding: Inner-join blending of two strategies with different rebalance schedules is mathematically equivalent to sub-sampling and should require explicit forward-fill to common grid. Charter v1.5 §13 should add a check: blend operations must use consistent rebalance frequency or document forward-fill protocol.
lessons_learned.tertiary_finding: Defense alpha at SIGNAL level passed 3-axis AX-001 v2 but at PORTFOLIO level (top-20 long-only HRP deployment) carries +60% MKT beta + +56% LVOL — not pure defense. The signal-vs-portfolio honesty gap is the structural AX-007 concern.
lessons_learned.proposed_l_code_text: Backtest Result Contract v1.0 audit must validate frequency-vs-cadence consistency. Frequency mislabel (declared 'daily' on bi-monthly inner-join 138-obs series) inflates Sharpe by sqrt(252/12)=4.58x and CAGR exponentially. Charter v1.5 §13 audit_bt_result function must compute median(diff(date)) and compare to declared frequency annualization_factor; mismatch triggers metric_type='unavailable' + integrity='FAIL'. Pattern: blend operations across strategies with different rebalance schedules require explicit forward-fill to common grid OR explicit relabeling to LCM frequency. WT-D20260429_001 Defense factor blend exemplar.
